verdict.rationale: Docs mention AI agents that can 'update records, trigger workflows, and connect to tools' in response to chat, implying some action-triggering capability, but there is no documentation of a rule/event definition system (e.g., 'when X happens, do Y') or automated triggers outside of chat-initiated agent actions. Missing for 10: explicit event/trigger rule builder, documented conditions for automatic triggering, and independent evidence of automation-depth beyond chat-driven agent actions.
